name: The First Morning Ritual
tagline: When a couple moves in AFTER construction, the kitchen makes breakfast without being asked.
body:
EVERY OTHER COUPLE BUILT THIS HOUSE BEFORE LIVING IN IT. You cannot be welcomed into a place you raised with your own hands — you ARE the welcome. Bryn and Torie are the heroines; nobody throws them a first morning.

SO THE RITUAL ONLY FIRES FOR ARRIVALS. Whoever wakes first starts the coffee. Whoever wakes second starts the eggs. By the time the new couple stumbles downstairs the whole kitchen smells like belonging and there is a plate with their names on it.

USED TWICE IN GHOST HAVEN'S HISTORY. Once for Sage and Zephi. Once for Isolde and Mikaela.

BOTH TIMES IVY TUCKED A SMALL PRESSED FLOWER UNDER THE FORK — unannounced, unrequested, not part of anybody's instructions. Mikaela cried. Ida held her. The kitchen pretended not to watch.
rules: Only for couples who arrive after the walls are already warm
First awake makes coffee; second awake makes eggs
Nobody organises it and nobody has ever had to
